note: The publication sets on /downloads: documents that belong together, each shown by a page of its PDF (preview: the page number) made by scripts/pdf-covers.py. Page counts are read from the PDFs when the site is built. The home page shows the sets listed in "home", in that order.

sets.title: Keycloak administration: one-time passwords
sets.product: Keycloak 26.8.2, open-source identity and access management
sets.about: Three guides for realm administrators: reset a user's OTP credential, troubleshoot sign-in codes, and choose an OTP policy. Every screen comes from a running Keycloak 26.8.2 server, and every behaviour the guides state was tested.

sets.title: KC1 prediction API documentation
sets.product: KC1 defect prediction, an MSc team project (FastAPI)
sets.basis: Karan's project, recorded against the running API
sets.about: A reference, a quick start and a troubleshooting guide for the project's prediction API, with the OpenAPI description it serves. Every request and response in them was recorded from the API.
sets.revision: Reference and troubleshooting at revision 1.1, quick start at 1.0, for API 1.0.1; published 19 November 2026
sets.kind: API reference, quick start, and troubleshooting

sets.title: ARF-1 training rig: maintenance and operator publications
sets.product: ARF-1, a training rig invented for this portfolio
sets.basis: Demonstration data: not approved maintenance data
sets.about: An S1000D Issue 6 common source database printed as a maintenance publication, an operator publication and an illustrated parts catalogue, with the CSDB, the offline IETM and the validation report. The modules validate against the official schemas; nobody qualified has verified the content, and each module says so.

sets.title: AI-ChainGuard: final report and paper
sets.product: AI-ChainGuard, an MSc team project: proof of where each machine-learning model came from
sets.about: The whole project in one document, following the six phases of the course brief, and a six-page IEEE-format paper on where cryptographic integrity stops and semantic trust begins.

sets.title: TrustNav: technical report and demonstration guide
sets.product: TrustNav, Karan's project: a trust score for satellite positions in a vehicle fleet
sets.about: The technical report: requirements, approach, how it works, results on recordings of real attacks from Jammertest 2024, a critical review and the project management. And a two-page guide for a reader who can't attend the demonstration.

sets.title: From a message to a published procedure
sets.product: A case study: an engineer's message about resetting MFA
sets.basis: Case study, with a simulated message
sets.about: One procedure, SD-IAM-007, taken from a rough message to a reviewed document: the analysis, the questions, the editorial decisions and the checks, then published by DITA Open Toolkit.
